name: bitrouter
description: BitRouter's official plugin marketplace — the agent plugin ships from the same repo as the router itself.

plugins.name: bitrouter
plugins.description: Route model calls and browse durable BRO conversations in native scrollback. Run Thread/Turn conversations with FIFO input, steering, six native tools (read, glob, grep, write, edit, shell), bounded read workers, configured MCP client tools, skills discovery and durable execution records on a background server. Bundles the BitRouter setup and operations skill, including ACP harnesses, request checks, and custom-host setup.
